llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news/search API and its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions: it performs HTTP queries against agenttimes.live. Declared dependency is only curl which is sufficient and expected for the provided curl examples; no unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is a set of curl examples and endpoint descriptions which stay within the news/search scope. Two notes: (1) /ask may fall back to web search (it may query third‑party search engines), so search queries leave the skill and go to external services; (2) the POST /subscribe flow requires you to provide a webhook URL — that webhook will receive article payloads from the service, so avoid registering sensitive internal endpoints as webhooks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no files are written to disk. Instruction-only skill that relies on an existing curl binary — lowest-risk install profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. That is proportional: the API is documented as free for /ask and requires no API key for basic use. There are no surprising secret requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent presence or modify other skills or system configuration; autonomous invocation remains allowed (platform default) but this is not combined with other red flags.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a thin, coherent wrapper around https://agenttimes.live and appears safe to install. Before using subscriptions, don't register sensitive internal endpoints as webhook targets — treat webhook URLs like secrets. Avoid sending private credentials or sensitive data as search queries because queries may be sent to the service and, when falling back, to external web search engines. No API keys or elevated permissions are requested by the skill itself.
